result.summary: Hawaii’s Employees’ Retirement System (ERS) seeks qualified firms to provide private equity investment consulting and management services, with discretion over certain decisions for part of the assets. Firms must be U.S.-based, registered under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, in business at least five years, and have a defined-benefit public pension client with over $3 billion in assets. The lead consultant must have at least seven years’ experience serving public pension plans in domestic and international consulting and management. The RFP is available from October 3, 2017, at 9 a.m. Hawaii time by calling (808) 586-1705 or through the ERS and State Procurement Office websites. Firms seeking addenda must register as potential offerors at dbf.ers.investmentprocure@hawaii.gov. Proposals are due November 27, 2017, by 4:30 p.m. Hawaii time; late submissions will not be considered. The RFP contact address is 201 Merchant Street, Suite 1400, Honolulu, HI 96813-2980.
